title: Bora Employer Pipeline Experience Record
description: Canonical identity record for one Experience_ID. Answers only whether the ID exists and what real experience it identifies. Does not store evidence facts, claim wording, résumé bullets, capabilities, technologies, dates, formal titles, or measured outcomes.

experience_id.description: Permanent unique identifier for this experience.

experience_name.description: Stable human-readable identity label for the experience.

experience_type.description: Conservative relationship classification. Prefer ORGANIZATIONAL_ENGAGEMENT over EMPLOYMENT or PERSONAL_PROJECT when stronger employment/project classification is not yet authorized by source evidence.

organization.description: Organization or hosting entity associated with the experience identity. May equal experience_name when the experience is the organization/project brand.

source_of_truth.description: Repository-grounded provenance for this identity record itself (not a dump of evidence facts).

notes.description: Optional identity clarifications or caveats. May be omitted. Must not assert unsupported title, dates, outcomes, or equivalence.
